title: Polynomial-time verifier for tautology complements
statement: Let $V$ be the language of binary strings $z$ for which there is an index $i$ satisfying $|z|=i+(i+1)$ such that the DNF formula decoded from the first $i$ bits of $z$ evaluates to false under the assignment given by the remaining $i+1$ bits, with all variables beyond those bits assigned false. If $V$ belongs to $	ext{P}$, then the language of binary strings whose decoded DNF formula is a tautology belongs to coNP.
hypotheses_covered: The verifier language belongs to P
replaced:
Let $V$ be the set of binary strings $z$ with $|z| = i + (i + 1)$ for some $i$ such
that the DNF decoded from the first $i$ bits of $z$ is false under the assignment
reading variable $v$ off the $v$-th of the remaining bits (false beyond them). If $V$
belongs to $\mathrm{P}$, then $\mathrm{TAUTOLOGY}$ belongs to coNP.
